title: 1953 AHSME Problem 40
statement: The negation of the statement “all men are honest,” is:

solutions.text:
The negation of “every man is honest” is “there exists a man who is not honest.” In the language of the choices, some men are dishonest.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: To disprove a universal statement, only one counterexample is needed
Negating “every man is honest” asserts that at least one man is not honest
